meaning: n. 一项日常杂务（这里指家务）
en: I usually do my household chores on Saturday morning.
zh: 我通常周六早上做家务。

en: We divided the work between the two teams.
zh: 我们把工作分给了两个团队。
tip: divide the work between two people（把工作分给两个人）

en: We each paid an equal share of the bill.
zh: 这笔账单我们各付了同样多的钱。
tip: an equal share of something（某事物中同等的一份）

en: It’s my responsibility to lock up after practice.
zh: 训练结束后由我负责锁门。
tip: It’s someone’s responsibility to do something（做某事是某人的职责）

en: We rotate meeting duties every month.
zh: 我们每月轮换一次会议分工。
